parameters.content:
## Drive → Shopify Image Sync

**Two-phase architecture (no nested loops):**

**Phase 1 → Collect** (Iterate Sheets loop)
`Load Sheet Names → Iterate Sheets → Read Sheet Rows → Collect to Static Data`
Reads all 19 sheets one at a time using the dedicated Google Sheets node.
Filtered product rows are accumulated in workflow static data.

**Phase 2 → Process** (Iterate Products loop)
`Get Collected Products → Iterate Products → Drive lookups → Upload → Update Sheet`
Starts only after Phase 1 finishes. Processes the flat list of products one at a time.

**Image naming (case-insensitive before extension):**
- Filename ending `-P` → IMAGE URL1 + Picture column
- Filename ending `-S` → IMAGE URL2
- All others → IMAGE URL3, IMAGE URL4 …

**Setup:** Connect Google Drive OAuth2 and Shopify OAuth2 credentials.
Google Sheets (`Template_control`) is already wired.

**Self-healing (Phase 1.5):** after each sheet is read, every existing
`IMAGE URL1-10` is HEAD-checked on the Shopify CDN. A 404/410 is only a *suspect* -- Shopify's CDN has a documented
propagation delay after uploads/renames/deletes, so a single miss isn't proof.
Suspects are re-checked once more after 45s; only ones still dead are re-queued
for a full fresh upload from Drive (Drive is the source of truth).

**Upload safety:** images over 4800 px / 24 MP are downscaled before upload
(Shopify rejects >25 MP); `fileCreate` errors and FAILED processing fail the run
loudly instead of silently leaving slots empty; URLs are only written once every
file is READY *and* the exact URL has been confirmed live on the CDN (HEAD 200) --
Shopify can rename a file during processing (`_1`/uuid suffix), which would
otherwise leave a broken link in the sheet.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'mutation stagedUploadsCreate($input: [StagedUploadInput!]!) { stagedUploadsCreate(input: $input) { stagedTargets { url resourceUrl parameters { name value } } userErrors { field message } } }', variables: { input: [{ resource: 'IMAGE', filename: $json.fileName, mimeType: $json.mimeType, httpMethod: 'POST' }] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'mutation fileCreate($files: [FileCreateInput!]!) { fileCreate(files: $files) { files { id alt fileStatus } userErrors { field message } } }', variables: { files: [{ alt: $('🔀 Split Per Image').item.json.slot, contentType: 'IMAGE', originalSource: $('🎯 Staged Create').item.json.data.stagedUploadsCreate.stagedTargets[0].resourceUrl }] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'query getFiles($ids: [ID!]!) { nodes(ids: $ids) { ... on GenericFile { id alt fileStatus url } ... on MediaImage { id alt fileStatus image { url width height } } } }', variables: { ids: ($json.uploadedFiles || []).map(f => f.id) } }) }}
